binding.fixedSubject: one vintage white porcelain teacup (fine bone china) with a thin delicate gold rim and an ornate gold handle to the right, sitting on a matching white porcelain saucer, viewed from directly overhead in a perfect flat-lay, filled with dark near-black coffee, large and positioned in the EXACT dead center of the vertical frame, the cup and saucer filling the width with the saucer edges reaching the left and right edges of the frame, equal black space above and below, on a pure solid black background — the mindfulsources CoffeeTok look
binding.motion: Only the coffee surface moves: the tan crema drifts slowly and gently clockwise like real liquid under surface tension, fine micro-foam wisps stretch and relax, tiny rim bubbles hold their size. The white porcelain cup, gold rim, gold handle, and saucer stay perfectly fixed and still — no cup rotation, no drift, no zoom. Locked overhead camera, pure black background, photorealistic, empty closed frame — nothing pours or enters, no pitcher, no jug, no kettle, no pour stream, no liquid poured in, no hand, no arm, no object enters from any edge, the scene is complete and unchanged except the coffee surface, no people, no spoon, no second cup, no steam, no text, gentle seamless loop.
binding.qualityGuards: photorealistic macro food photograph, EXACTLY ONE vintage white porcelain teacup on its saucer and nothing else, the crema is REAL, clean and appetizing — genuine fresh-coffee foam (golden crema over clean dark coffee), whether a full bright layer or a sparse scatter of fine golden bubbles; NEVER a muddy, uniform, flat, or manufactured dark blob; candid with fine natural micro-foam and tiny bubbles (never latte art, never a milky latte, never a painted or CGI graphic), soft even diffuse studio light, matte surface with no plastic or glossy sheen, flat pure black (#000000) background with NO gradient, vignette, or grey wash, the cup+saucer large and dead-center, saucer edges reaching the left and right frame edges, with equal generous black caption space above and below, absolutely nothing else in frame — no second cup, no spoon, no hands, no arms, no people, no steam, no food, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, sharp focus, vertical 9:16 portrait
